Downloaded https://www.stonybrook.edu/electrical/faculty/faculty-directory.html (HTTP 200, 35b59241995d7b1727cf4f92a49a3e31c5bcab37a0a9fbe91a34efd3c6e2869f sha256 over raw bytes, retrieved 2026-11-25T01:39:17+00:00). Parsed all five tab panels (Core Faculty 39 cards, Affiliated Faculty 12, Research Faculty 6, Adjunct Faculty 11, Emeritus Faculty 2; panels are hidden in the markup but present in the bytes). 70 cards map to 69 distinct names.
Enumeration check: all 69 names on the page match brief.people exactly; no omissions in either direction.

Membership convention: all 69 people are listed on the ECE department's own roster, so membership is ece for every record. Excluded records carry membership ece as a unit-listing fact; the decision and category carry the counting outcome. No cs_only or outside_ece membership appears on this page.
No incoming, courtesy, or joint/secondary markers appear in the downloaded page, so no effective_from_json dates were set (null) and no incoming records were created.

Research Faculty cards (Athalye, Boukhicha, Feng, Kipshidze, O. Tchoubar, Belenky) show no rank. Decided excluded as research_only; the exclusion holds under research_staff too, so the count is unaffected.
Only the single directory list was required and downloaded; supporting_urls was empty. Individual profile pages were optional and not fetched, so no profile-level corroboration was used.
